documentation: Example OBS Studio setup for the AetherWorkspace v1.1 local capture. Configure this in OBS Studio on the Windows 11 laptop; never commit the WebSocket password or raw media.

recording.outputDirectory: local capture directory, never inside the repository

sources.note: Capture only the demo monitor/region; exclude personal notifications and unrelated windows.

safety: Do not bind the WebSocket to 0.0.0.0 or expose it through a firewall.
Do not store the WebSocket password in the public repository; use the local environment variable.
Raw MKV/MP4/GIF files stay local until human review and explicit publication approval.
